outcome: Fetal complications (sepsis, congenital heart block, prematurity, low birth weight)
cohort: 98 patients with inflammatory rheumatic diseases attending a joint rheumatology and obstetric clinic in the UK between January 2018 and January 2020
finding: This service model for pregnant women with inflammatory rheumatic diseases was associated with favourable outcomes, including a high live birth rate (97%), low miscarriage rate (2%), and a high median birth weight (3120 g).
mod_finding: 30% of patients had emergency Caesarean sections.
